He is one of the most decorated players in North America, despite having only played ''CS:GO'' since the summer of 2014. On January 11th, 2016, he joined [[Cloud9]]; although the announcement was met with criticism from both professionals and the public, '''Stewie2K''' soon became known as one of the best players in [[Cloud9]]. After two years on the roster and a [[Majors|Major]] title under his belt, he decided to move on and join Gabriel "[[FalleN]]" Toledo's [[SK Gaming]]/[[MIBR]] squad. Following months of up-and-down results, he returned to his North American roots and joined [[Team Liquid]].
